entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you're through to VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about a cycling jersey I ordered a while back. I finally had a chance to try it on for a real ride, and I think I got the wrong size.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you happen to have your order number?
Yes, it's VF-94301-B. The main issue is that the jersey is just too tight across the chest and shoulders.
Thank you. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Mesh Jersey, delivered on October 30th, which was 45 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy for you.

Alright, I've checked, and you're all set. Our policy allows for returns on standard apparel within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that window, we can absolutely process a return or an exchange for you.

That's a relief. I'd prefer to do an exchange for the next size up. Since I'm having to go through this process, is there any way you could include a small discount on the new item? It would make the whole process feel smoother.

I appreciate you asking. While I can't add a discount for a standard size exchange, I can confirm that we'll cover the shipping for the new size being sent to you. There will be no extra cost for that.
Alright, free shipping on the replacement is fair. So, what's the next step to get this jersey that's too tight sent back and get the right one?

I've just initiated the exchange in our system. I'm sending an email to you right now with a pre-paid return label. Just print that out, package the jersey, and drop it at the post office. Once we see the return has been scanned, we'll dispatch the larger size to you immediately.
Perfect. That sounds easy enough. Thank you for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that covers it. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
